name: OwnPhoneBot
tagline: Puts a genuine, callable phone number onto your own assistant
description: Connects a real telephone number to an assistant by taking the fiddly provisioning off your hands: it signs you up with the telephone provider and installs an Asterisk server so the two ends can talk. Ownership stays with you, and so do the bills, since the provider and the model vendor both charge you directly.
author: lafraia
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
